title: File chats, journal, plans, and the roadmap under .ai

costar.context: The repo on D:\localdev\mail-shippin\shippin-tech already copies Cursor transcripts with .ai/machine/copy_chats.py. Skills, the journal schema, plans, and the roadmap were not there yet.
costar.objective: Add tool-agnostic skills and a checker so chats, journal entries, plans, and the roadmap stay valid as the tree grows.
costar.style: Short skills plus a schema-backed program.
costar.audience: The next coding agent and the maintainer.
costar.response: Canonical files under .ai, Cursor junctions to those skills, and organize.py --check exiting 0.

concerns: The enterprise license validator source is not in this tree. LicenseKey::new stays fail-closed. This plan does not invent a key checker.
A cargo build with full debuginfo ran out of memory on this machine. The roadmap phase build stays in_progress until a fresh build exits 0.
Hooks fire only when Cursor has this D: folder open. The Downloads copy has no .ai tree.
A check that only validated one fixture would miss a bad line already filed in a session. The check walks every jsonl line.
context: Wardenclyffe already separates session_event, agent_message, tool_event, and journal_entry. This repo stores those as files because SurrealDB is not running here.
current_state: copy_chats.py has filed the Cursor transcripts. organize.py rejects a journal entry whose entry_type is not in the Wardenclyffe list and then validates every filed line.
target_design: Skills live once under .ai/skills. .cursor/skills junctions point at them. Journal lines, plans, and the roadmap are accepted only when they match .ai/schema. New transcript bytes append; unchanged files add nothing.
changes: Add .ai/schema for journal_entry, session_event, agent_message, tool_event, reasoning, plan, and roadmap.
Add the three skills and the roadmap.
Point AGENTS.md and the Cursor operating rule at those files.
boundaries: Do not mint or accept an enterprise license key.
Do not treat a journal entry as a copy of the chat.
Do not mark the build phase done.

verification.name: schema-rejects-bad-journal-and-accepts-filed-chats
verification.proves: An unknown journal type is rejected, and every already filed event, message, and tool line matches its schema.

verification.name: unchanged-transcript-adds-nothing
verification.proves: A second sync of unchanged transcripts writes no new events.
verification.expected: skipped equals files and events is 0
